summary: Dispatches font character rendering on the character code at a2+8. Special code 9875 (with a5 in {397, 426}) renders via sub_412490 then DecrementCounterWithFloorAtZero; special code 9876 (with a5 in 1..2) uses EnumValueTranslation then the same counter decrement. The general case resolves a field index with GlobalFieldSelectorByIndex(a1) (negative result returns -1), takes the string at *(a2) falling back to byte_5EA438 when null, copies it via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, and writes the code, field index and a zero flag into the a4 output buffer (+8/+12/+16), returning 1. Called by FontRenderingPrep (00411840).

local_names.a1: context used by GlobalFieldSelectorByIndex for the general-case field lookup
local_names.a2: font character state block; +8 holds the character code, +0 the string pointer
local_names.a3: parent state; +20 supplies the value consumed by the special-code handlers
local_names.a4: output buffer; receives copied string and mapped code/field/flag values
local_names.a5: variant selector validated per character code
local_names.v10: string pointer read from *(a2), defaulting to byte_5EA438 when null
local_names.v11: character code captured for the output buffer write

operations.description: Reads the character code at a2+8 and branches on it; codes 9875 and 9876 take dedicated paths
Code 9875 with a5 outside {397, 426} returns -1 immediately
sub_412490(a4, 1, *(a3+20), 0, 0) renders the special 9875 character into the a4 buffer
Code 9876 with a5 not in the range 1..2 returns -1 immediately
EnumValueTranslation(a4, *(a3+20)) translates the value for special code 9876
GlobalFieldSelectorByIndex(a1) resolves the field index for the general case; a negative result returns -1
Source string v10 = *(a2); when *(a2) is null it defaults to byte_5EA438
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v10) copies the string into a reallocated buffer
Writes mapped values into the output buffer a4: character code v11 to +8, field index v9 to +12, and zero flag to +16
Returns 1 on the general success path, v6/v8 on the two special-code paths, and -1 on every rejected path
Invoked by FontRenderingPrep as part of font rendering preparation

unresolved: Offsets read on a2 (+8, +0) and a3 (+20) describe the font character state block and its parent data, but the packet declares no field evidence refs for them
Writes at a4+8/+12/+16 describe an output buffer whose struct layout is not evidenced
Literals 9875, 9876, 397, 426 are character-code/variant constants; their exact meaning is unproven
